title: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1973-10-25
source: Source: Soundboard > Master-Reel > Reel (1st gen) > DAT (44.1k)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a late‑1973 Madison show with a soaring Weather Report Suite, Jerry’s jaw‑dropping bends on Tennessee Jed and Bob Weir’s vocal flourish on Saturday Night; recording is clear aside from a brief cut.
ai_review.review: The performance ranks among fans’ top ten, highlighted by an explosive Weather Report Suite, Jerry Garcia’s expressive string bending toward the end of “Tennessee Jed,” and Bobby Weir’s soaring vocal flourishes on “Saturday Night.” The soundboard source delivers a clean mix, though one reviewer notes a small splice in the JED track. Overall it’s a must‑listen for anyone exploring the band’s late‑'73 era.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4–5 stars and praised both musical performance and overall sound; only a minor tape cut is mentioned, so the rating stays high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced; one reviewer mentions a brief cut/splice in the “Tennessee Jed” segment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy late‑1973 set with strong transitions and adventurous improvisations; fans describe it as a top‑ten, out‑of‑this‑world experience.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted for expressive string bending toward the end of “Tennessee Jed.”
band_member_comments.Bob: Praised for vocal flourishes on “Saturday Night,” sounding better than his later falsetto work.
